answer.justification: Only activation measurements are available. The layer-1 difference is 0.037, below every category's range (quantized 0.096-0.105, fine-tuned 0.086-0.092, system-prompted 0.113-0.133), and the layer-2 spike is tiny at 0.2. The tiny spike rules out system-prompted, which shows 31.7-64.0, and the early onset at layer 2 also fits poorly with its onset at layers 7-8. Quantized is unlikely because its difference is already about 0.10 at layer 1 and then stays flat, whereas this one grows steadily to 0.551 at layer 32 with a cosine of 0.839. Fine-tuned fits best: direction consistency 0.614 is within the 0.618-0.705 range and the onset is early. The mid-layer size ratio of 0.978 is below 1 and the rank of 3.89 is high, which are atypical for fine-tuning, and the final-layer values are larger than any seen, so confidence is moderate. A low-rank adapter that barely touches early layers but grows later is the most plausible explanation.
